page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The processor includes a 504 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. System memory totals 120 GB, yielding a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled with five local NVMe SSDs providing a total capacity of 1745 GB. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core capabilities, with the Geekbench single-core score and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rates placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-threaded decompression and overall Geekbench multi-core performance rank in the top 25%. The CPU features advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for integer and tile operations, which support cryptographic and vector processing workloads. Memory bandwidth reaches 2707.87 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, though large-block uncached writes drop to 29.86 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of high-speed local NVMe storage alongside a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides high resource density for data-intensive applications without the overhead of external storage attachments. The server is configured for workloads requiring rapid local data access and strong integer math performance. Suitable use cases include static web serving, intermediate database operations, text processing, and small-to-medium scale language model inference.
